The '''Civic Center''' was a building that was located in the town [[Forard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conference was held in the conference room of the Civic Center, to discuss an attempt that had been made to implicate the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in a plot to crash a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] into Almas. A delegation from [[Cularin SpaceNav]], [[Ul-Modo]] of the [[Cularin Militia]], the [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of [[Hedrett Shipping and Investments]], [[E1-6RA]] of the [[Almas Academy]] and the [[heroes of Cularin]] all attended the conference.
